independence_statement: Saved before opening local spot, source, media or prior candidate records for these 25 names. Candidate selection used external discovery only.
method_limits: Coordinates are approximate discovery points and do not prove a launch.
Protected-area permission is unresolved unless explicitly sourced.
Full draft/cloud duplication access remained unavailable.

spots.name: Moledo
spots.identity: Praia de Moledo at Caminha, outside supervised bathing water.
spots.conditions: Windy exposed beach with strong waves; year-round surf and summer windsurf are documented.
spots.access_rules: Attach flags, bathing sectors and Camarido protected-area access.
spots.trip_value: Northern scenery, established wind use and year-round surf support worth_trip after rules are attached.

spots.name: Cabedelo, Viana do Castelo
spots.identity: The north and south sections of Cabedelo's groyne must be treated as different riding areas.
spots.conditions: Strong wind; north section favours windsurf, while the longer south beach supports surf and kite use.
spots.access_rules: Map the discipline sections, dunes, supervised water and current rescue coverage.
spots.trip_value: International events, dual conditions and dense instruction infrastructure support worth_trip.

spots.name: Ofir
spots.identity: The southern surf section of Praia de Ofir, separate from the central bathing area.
spots.conditions: Atlantic beach beside the Cávado mouth; southern section has better swell and low-tide rocks emerge.
spots.access_rules: Respect the protected coastal landscape, bathing zone and river-mouth hazards.
spots.trip_value: Protected dune/forest setting and established sports make a defensible worth_trip destination.

spots.name: Matosinhos Beach
spots.identity: The sheltered city beach immediately south of Leixões port.
spots.conditions: Mostly small sheltered waves suited to learning; rocks and stronger lefts occur at one edge.
spots.access_rules: Keep clear of port limits, rocks and crowded supervised bathing water.
spots.trip_value: Excellent local training access, but insufficient dedicated-trip value compared with nearby Atlantic destinations.

spots.name: Espinho – Praia da Baía
spots.identity: The breakwater-defined Praia da Baía and its Casino wave.
spots.conditions: Breakwaters shelter much of the bay; the recognised wave and crowd vary with bank and swell.
spots.access_rules: Separate concession/bathing space and add current/crowd guidance.
spots.trip_value: One of northern Portugal's better-known waves, schools and WSL events support worth_trip after exact peak guidance.

spots.name: Praia da Barra, Aveiro
spots.identity: Ocean beach beside Aveiro harbour entrance; harbour water is excluded.
spots.conditions: Multiple consistent Atlantic peaks; harbour structures and strong water movement need local assessment.
spots.access_rules: Follow port exclusion, supervised bathing and flags.
spots.trip_value: Consistent multi-sport surf, lighthouse setting and services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Cabedelo, Figueira da Foz
spots.identity: Praia do Cabedelo south of the Mondego mouth.
spots.conditions: Large dune-backed beachbreak with multiple schools; river-mouth and jetty effects require current guidance.
spots.access_rules: Use dune walkways and respect port, swimming and school sectors.
spots.trip_value: Historic competition venue, schools and multi-discipline conditions support worth_trip.

spots.name: Buarcos – Tamargueira
spots.identity: The long right at Tamargueira/Buarcos, not the entire urban beach.
spots.conditions: Very long sectional right can run from Cabo Mondego; summer crowd and rocks/sections require advanced judgement.
spots.access_rules: Pin entry/exit and add rock, crowd, level and tide constraints.
spots.trip_value: Internationally known as Europe's longest wave and a destination of renowned surfers; exceeds worth_trip.

spots.name: São Pedro de Moel
spots.identity: The bay beach at São Pedro de Moel.
spots.conditions: Bay shelter reduces north wind while surf remains available year-round.
spots.access_rules: Respect flags, rocky margins and supervised water.
spots.trip_value: Year-round surf, distinctive pine-coast setting and services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Foz do Arelho
spots.identity: Lagoon windsurf water and ocean surf beach are separate entries at the Óbidos Lagoon mouth.
spots.conditions: Calmer windy lagoon contrasts with exposed ocean surf; inlet geometry and current change.
spots.access_rules: Map north-bank launch, inlet current, bathers and navigation sectors.
spots.trip_value: Two water states, schools and heritage access support worth_trip after launch correction.

spots.name: Santa Cruz, Torres Vedras
spots.identity: Santa Cruz's competition beach system; an exact peak must be selected.
spots.conditions: Exposed rugged coast with powerful event-quality waves and multiple peaks.
spots.access_rules: Attach peak, level, rocks/current and supervised-zone details.
spots.trip_value: International competitions and strong coastal destination value support worth_trip without enough evidence for world_class.

spots.name: Praia da Areia Branca
spots.identity: The main supervised beach at Areia Branca.
spots.conditions: Active sea supports both learning and regular surfing; precise hazards are not published.
spots.access_rules: Retain flags, supervision and school-led level choice.
spots.trip_value: Consistent region, schools, hostel and services support worth_trip.

spots.name: Lagoa de Albufeira
spots.identity: Lagoon launch and sea-facing surf beach are distinct.
spots.conditions: Calm lagoon supports wind sports; inlet has dangerous underwater currents and ocean side has strong waves.
spots.access_rules: Map the legal launch, seasonal inlet opening, swimmers and protected dunes.
spots.trip_value: Unusual lagoon/ocean combination and established use support worth_trip after zoning correction.

spots.name: Fonte da Telha
spots.identity: The established beach-school section at Fonte da Telha.
spots.conditions: Open Atlantic coast with wind and wave use; cliff and seasonal crowd affect access.
spots.access_rules: Use current school/rescue sector and protect fossil-cliff landscape and bathers.
spots.trip_value: Certified school, rescue/rental and long Caparica coast support worth_trip.

spots.name: São João da Caparica
spots.identity: The wind-sport/surf sections at São João, not the whole Caparica urban frontage.
spots.conditions: Atlantic beachbreak and strong coastal wind; groynes and crowd make section selection material.
spots.access_rules: Pin a legal launch and current bathing-season corridor.
spots.trip_value: Lisbon access and nationally recognised wind-sport use support worth_trip after exact-zone correction.

spots.name: Praia do Meco
spots.identity: Moinho de Baixo/Meco beach; naturist and sports sections must remain explicit.
spots.conditions: Frequently rough sea with powerful swell.
spots.access_rules: Respect licensed naturist sector, flags and swimmer separation.
spots.trip_value: Strong conditions and distinctive Sesimbra setting support worth_trip after section correction.

spots.name: Tróia
spots.identity: Unresolved Tróia peninsula wind-sport candidate; no exact launch established.
spots.conditions: Sheltered estuary-facing and exposed ocean-facing waters differ materially.
spots.access_rules: Dolphin habitat, navigation, bathing and concession rules require an exact authority map.
spots.trip_value: Peninsula trip value is strong, but sport identity and permission are too generic to count now.

spots.name: São Torpes
spots.identity: Praia de São Torpes south of Sines.
spots.conditions: Consistent exposed coast with level-dependent peaks; precise current/industrial-water context needs updating.
spots.access_rules: Use school and supervised sectors; retain local water-quality and current advisories.
spots.trip_value: Regional-leading surf, year-round schools and major events support worth_trip.

spots.name: Malhão / Milfontes
spots.identity: Malhão ocean beach near Vila Nova de Milfontes; Mira estuary is separate.
spots.conditions: Consistent Costa Vicentina surf; open beach hazards and remote sections require local selection.
spots.access_rules: Natural-park access, dunes and supervised sections must be respected.
spots.trip_value: Year-round instruction, consistent waves and protected-coast journey support worth_trip after exact beach mapping.

spots.name: Odeceixe
spots.identity: Ocean side of Odeceixe beach at the Seixe river mouth.
spots.conditions: River and Atlantic create changing bars and currents; beach exposure varies by tide.
spots.access_rules: Separate river bathing water from ocean surf and retain natural-park/current warnings.
spots.trip_value: Dramatic river-mouth setting and established Costa Vicentina surf support worth_trip.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.identity: Arrifana's cliff-enclosed beach and established surf peaks.
spots.conditions: Sheltered bay still receives powerful Atlantic swell; cliffs, crowd and access constrain use.
spots.access_rules: Follow supervision, parking/access and level guidance.
spots.trip_value: Year-round surf, infrastructure and exceptional cliff setting support worth_trip.

spots.name: Praia do Amado
spots.identity: Amado's exposed Costa Vicentina beachbreak.
spots.conditions: Multiple exposed peaks and strong conditions, with schools and events serving different levels.
spots.access_rules: Respect natural-park access, flags, currents and school areas.
spots.trip_value: International competitions, schools and remote coast support worth_trip; evidence stops short of world_class.

spots.name: Jardim do Mar
spots.identity: Madeira's Jardim do Mar point/reef-break system.
spots.conditions: Large, constant, powerful North Atlantic point and reef waves for advanced/expert surfers.
spots.access_rules: Entry/exit, reef, swell and rescue limits must be explicit.
spots.trip_value: Official tourism explicitly assigns world-class status and international cult reputation; exclude from worth_trip.

spots.name: Paul do Mar
spots.identity: Paul do Mar's wave and wind-sport coast, separate from neighbouring Jardim do Mar.
spots.conditions: Reef/point surf and year-round wind use are documented only at destination level.
spots.access_rules: Pin the exact wave/launch, level, entry/exit and rescue limitations.
spots.trip_value: Madeira journey and recognised surf support worth_trip only after exact identity correction.

spots.name: Santa Bárbara, São Miguel
spots.identity: Areal de Santa Bárbara's long beachbreak at Ribeira Grande.
spots.conditions: Exposed experienced-surfer beachbreak with long sand area and changing peaks.
spots.access_rules: Retain level, current, flags and seasonal supervision guidance.
spots.trip_value: Azorean island journey, established surf and resort/services support worth_trip.
